user.title: Color Temperature Light Mixer CW
user.description: Combine two lights of different color temperatures into a single light entity. Color temperature priority keeps kelvin exact and treats 100% as the brightest mix at that kelvin.

data_description.name: The name of the light
data_description.warm_light_entity_id: Light acting as the warmer light source (yellow-ish color)
data_description.warm_light_color_temp_kelvin: Color temperature of the warm light source (in Kelvin). This is the virtual light minimum.
data_description.cold_light_entity_id: Light acting as the colder light source (blu-ish color)
data_description.cold_light_color_temp_kelvin: Color temperature of the cold light source (in Kelvin). This is the virtual light maximum.
data_description.priority: Color temperature keeps kelvin exact (2700K with WW full / CW off reports 100%). Brightness keeps both channels contributing to 100% and may shift kelvin.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure mixer
reconfigure.description: Warm/cold entities and their kelvin values set the virtual light range. Priority chooses max-at-CCT vs both-channels-full.

init.title: Mixer settings
init.description: These are the same fields as the original mixer. Warm/cold kelvin are the min/max of the virtual light. Priority color temperature: 100% is the maximum at that kelvin.

data_description.warm_light_entity_id: Entity that drives the warm-white channel
data_description.warm_light_color_temp_kelvin: Kelvin of the WW LEDs (virtual light minimum, e.g. 2700)
data_description.cold_light_entity_id: Entity that drives the cold-white channel
data_description.cold_light_color_temp_kelvin: Kelvin of the CW LEDs (virtual light maximum, e.g. 6500)
data_description.priority: Color temperature: 2700K + 90% stays 2700K and 90%. Brightness: 100% is both channels full and kelvin may drift.
